item.text:
**8B.6 Assessment:** Mixed, leaning positive on concrete execution. Jokowi’s 2024 record includes several observable implementations of declared programs, especially on Nusantara, macro management, health delivery, social-targeting infrastructure, and crisis response. But the same year also shows major gaps: patronage, election-rule manipulation, coercive information control, and serious abuses in Papua mean state reach was not consistently clean, neutral, or fully accountable.

**Evidence**
- (E0005) [Presiden Jokowi resmikan Plaza Seremoni Sumbu Kebangsaan di IKN](https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-resmikan-plaza-seremonial-sumbu-kebangsaan-di-ibu-kota-nusantara/) - Presidential Secretariat of the Republic of Indonesia, 2024-08-14. A declared flagship capital project became an observable milestone on the ground, not just a slogan. Questions: 8B.6, 8B.2, 8B.3.
- (E0363) [Laporan Kebijakan Moneter Triwulan I 2024](https://www.bi.go.id/en/publikasi/laporan/Pages/Laporan-Kebijakan-Moneter-Triwulan-I-2024.aspx) - Bank Indonesia, 2024-04-30. BI’s preemptive rate hikes and inflation-defense tools show declared macro goals being turned into actual policy action. Questions: 8B.6, 8B.4, 8B.5.
- (E0446) [WHO: Indonesia country profile / JKN and Mobile JKN](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240100893) - World Health Organization, 2024-12-06. Universal health coverage was not just proclaimed; it was embedded in service access, lower out-of-pocket costs, and simpler enrollment/payment systems. Questions: 8B.6, 8B.4, 8B.5.
- (E0650) [Indonesia ramps up capacities to detect and respond to outbreaks of emerging and epidemic-prone diseases](https://www.who.int/indonesia/news-room/item/30-08-2024-indonesia-ramps-up-capacities-to-detect-and-respond-to-outbreaks-of-emerging-and-epidemic-prone-diseases) - WHO Indonesia, 2024-08-30. The nationwide training of rapid-response teams in 514 districts is concrete evidence of operational reach, not symbolic health rhetoric. Questions: 8B.6, 8B.5.
- (E0479) [Bappenas perkuat dukungan untuk anak-anak dan keluarga rentan / Regsosek](https://www.unicef.org/indonesia/id/press-releases/bappenas-perkuat-dukungan-untuk-anak-anak-dan-keluarga-rentan) - UNICEF Indonesia, 2024-04-25. Regsosek is a real implementation tool for targeting and transparency in social assistance, showing state capacity beyond speeches. Questions: 8B.6, 8B.4, 8B.5.
- (E0468) [Jokowi orders audit of Indonesia's data centres after cyberattack](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/3268495/jokowi-orders-audit-indonesias-data-centres-after-cyberattack) - Reuters via South China Morning Post, 2024-06-28. A service-disrupting cyber failure was met with a cross-government audit, which is limited but real corrective follow-through. Questions: 8B.6, 8B.5.
- (E0609) [Analysis: A decade of Jokowi... leaves illiberal legacy, critics say](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-10-14. Broad end-of-term analysis says strong development coexisted with patronage and dynastic politics, implying implementation was real but politically distorted. Questions: 8B.6, 8B.3, 8B.4, 8B.5.
- (E0599) [Outgoing Indonesian president gives cabinet jobs to loyalists of successor Prabowo](https://theprint.in/world/outgoing-indonesian-president-gives-cabinet-jobs-to-loyalists-of-successor-prabowo/2228867/) - Reuters via ThePrint, 2024-08-19. Cabinet staffing was used for transition brokerage and loyalty management, not clean merit-only implementation. Questions: 8B.6, 8B.4, 8B.5, 8B.3.
- (E0618) [Protests across Indonesia as parliament delays change to election law](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-shelves-plan-revise-election-law-protests-rage-2024-08-22/) - Reuters, 2024-08-22. Rule changes widely seen as helping Jokowi’s son show that declared institutional norms were not cleanly translated into neutral practice. Questions: 8B.6, 4B.2, 7B.9.
- (E0288) [Freedom House: Indonesia, Freedom on the Net 2024](https://freedomhouse.org/country/indonesia/freedom-net/2024) - Freedom House, 2024. The state did convert information-control goals into reach and enforcement, but through overbroad blocking, takedowns, and harassment rather than constructive implementation. Questions: 8B.6, 8B.5, 4B.6.
- (E0155) [If It’s Not Racism, What Is It?](https://www.hrw.org/report/2024/09/18/if-it-s-not-racism-what-is-it/discrimination-and-other-abuses-against-papuans-in) - Human Rights Watch, 2024-09-18. In Papua, declared commitments to order and protection did not translate into disciplined, accountable enforcement; abuses and weak accountability remained severe. Questions: 8B.6, 8B.5.

**Search gap**
- I did not find a single 2024 whole-of-government implementation audit or scorecard for Jokowi that directly measures how consistently declarations became execution across ministries, regions, and agencies.
- The best evidence is sectoral: capital-project milestones, macro policy, health systems, social registry design, cyber crisis response, and human-rights reporting in Papua.
